Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Singhania Clinic & Therapy Centre is located in JLT, and has been in Dubai since 1996. The clinic was established by Dr. Rajeshree Singhania. Our elite team of professionals offers full developmental and psycho-educational evaluations and treatment for autism, ADHD and behavioural difficulties, along with general pediatrics and vaccinations.

Registered Nurse who will manage patient appointments, patient files, deal with patients and parents, assist in examination of patients in medical and assessment cases, and upload DHA statistics, as well as administer injections and collect blood samples.
You will also assist in treatment, sample collection and assist the doctor in report making, in administrative matters, and communicate with outside authorities when required.
Furthermore, you will be required to complete the following responsibilities:
Follow-up with potential patient leads from both the website, emails, WhatsApp and phone calls
Follow-up with existing patients about medication/ appointments / Therapy
Maintaining inventory, check sheets, & logging patient data
Assisting the Singhania Clinic Team with data input
Coordinating with Labs both in Dubai and USA
Able to conduct both clinical and administrative work
Acting as fire warden and ensuring clinic hygiene
q: A B.Sc. degree in Nursing accepted by DHA. No UAE experience necessary. A DHA Nursing Eligibility Letter and completed Data Flow in UAE would give you a definite edge. Fluent spoken and written English proficiency is mandatory. Must be personable, willing to handle difficult children and have basic computer knowledge. Ready to join immediately from the next day.
Basic AED 4,000 per month; Plus Visa, 20% transport allowance, 5% phone allowance, annual Return ticket to hometown.
